title: Same Truck Twice
description: A vehicle conflict is detected the same way a driver conflict is — two assignments sharing a vehicle with overlapping windows — but it needs to be reported as its own distinct resourceType, not lumped in with driver conflicts.
successCondition: Book two shipments. Assign both to the same vehicleId with two different driverIds and overlapping time windows. GET /api/fleet/conflicts returns a conflicts array containing an entry with resourceType exactly "vehicle" (not "driver"), resourceId equal to the shared vehicleId, and assignmentIds containing both assignment ids — and no driver-type conflict entry, since the two drivers are different.
hints: Fetch two distinct driverIds from GET /api/fleet/drivers so the driver dimension is deliberately NOT shared, isolating the vehicle conflict as the only overlap.
A single pair of overlapping assignments can produce up to two conflict entries (one per shared resource) — here you're confirming exactly one (vehicle), not two.
